name: Cortland Stacies
description: A White Greaser gang based in Chicago's Hermosa/Logan Square neighborhoods, active around Moffat and Campbell Avenue. The main rivals of the Bel-Airs, they were a precursor to the Moffat & Campbell Ave Gaylords and the Point St. Gaylords. Named after the Stacy Adams shoe popular among greasers of the era.
